notes: Full text for the links in news_gdelt_index, fetched from the publishers' own sites (recovery_source='live'). One row per GDELT link, with a status: ok, no_text (page loaded, no text found), gone (404/410: a candidate for the Wayback Machine), failed (retried next run) or skipped_not_article. published_at is the page's own date; The Express Tribune stamps the last update, so first_public_at = min(published_at, seendate) is the point-in-time key and published_after_seen flags rows where the page date was later than GDELT's sighting. Coverage is bounded by GDELT's index: Business Recorder is absent from it for most of 2018-2022 and after 2025-11. Site terms restrict reproduction (see docs/data-sources.md): private, non-commercial research use only.
